statement.zh: Manning 等 2006 主张圣托里尼喷发在公元前 17 世纪晚期并使 LM IA–II 相对传统年代拉长约百年；Warren & Hankey 代表传统低年代——高/低年代仍开放。
statement.en: Manning et al. 2006 argue a late-17th-century BCE Thera eruption and stretched LM IA–II; Warren & Hankey represent traditional low chronology — high vs low remains open.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
